data.notes: All 20 searches were used. No VW press kits with full data sheets were found except the VW newsroom Golf 7 Variant page (trunk) and a Sportsvan price list. Dimensions mostly come from the ADAC Autokatalog, which reproduces manufacturer data. The Golf Plus was excluded as a different nameplate. For the Multivan, trunkL is null because only 7-seat values (about 576-657 l) and seats-removed maximums are published; these are given in the notes. The existing T7 entry uses 1850 l with the 3rd row removed. T6.1 (from 10/2019) is included as a separate generation.

Pre-facelift engines not in data: 1.2 TSI 85 PS and 110 PS, 1.6 TDI 110 PS, 2.0 TDI 150 PS (built from 02/14; parts-catalogue dates). The listed '1.6 TDI' could be given 110 PS; the 1.2 TSI power is 85 or 110 PS.

verification.notes: Golf IV Variant: VW newsroom confirms 1999-2006 production (presented April 1999) and trunk 460/1470 l, so yearFrom 1999 / yearTo 2006 are now sourced (https://www.volkswagen-newsroom.com/de/golf-4-variant-19992006-19522). Golf Sportsvan pre-facelift: 4338 length, 1807 width (carwow), 1578 height without roof rails (1598 with), 590/1520 l confirmed; wheelbase conflicts between VW sources (VW previous-models page and 2013 press pack 2685 mm; VW 'update' press release 2670 mm) so 2670 not corrected but uncertain. Golf V/VI Variant dimensions and years confirmed by VW newsroom profiles (4556/4534 x 1781 x 1504, wb 2578; VI trunk 505/1495). Golf VII Variant length/width/height and 605/1620 l confirmed. Multivan T5 dims and 4525 l max confirmed (fastcarcheck/encycarpedia); T5 facelift ADAC dims confirmed; T6: auto motor und sport lists 4892 x 1904 x 1970 mm for the 2015 4Motion (vs ADAC 4904 mm) and 657-4300 l - length not corrected since ADAC reproduces manufacturer data. T6.1 not independently checked. 13 searches used.
